description: book a recurring weekly home cleaning
utterances: i want someone to come tidy my flat every friday
I'm looking to set up a regular arrangement where a cleaner comes to my two-bedroom apartment once a week for about three hours, what would that cost?

description: book a one-off deep clean of the home
utterances: need the whole house scrubbed top to bottom just once
We're hosting family next month and the place hasn't had a proper going-over in years, I'd like a thorough single visit covering the oven, skirting boards and inside cupboards.

description: book a clean before handing back a rented flat
utterances: moving out next week and the landlord wants it spotless
My lease ends on the thirtieth and I need the whole place cleaned to the standard the letting agency expects so I can get my full deposit returned.

description: get a plumber for a leaking pipe
utterances: there's water dripping from under my kitchen sink
A joint on the pipe behind the toilet has started weeping and there's a puddle forming on the floor, how soon can you send someone out to fix it?

description: get a plumber to unblock a drain
utterances: my shower won't drain at all anymore
The kitchen sink has been backing up for days and I've tried a plunger and drain cleaner with no luck, I need a professional to clear whatever is stuck.

description: get an electrician for a circuit that keeps tripping
utterances: the fuse box keeps cutting out whenever i use the kettle
Every evening the switch in the consumer unit flips and half the house goes dark, I've reset it a dozen times, can someone come and find the fault?

description: get an electrician to install a light fitting
utterances: can someone come hang a new ceiling lamp in the lounge
I bought a pendant fixture for the dining room and there's an existing rose on the ceiling, I'd like a qualified person to wire it up safely.

description: book a crew for a house move
utterances: need a van and two guys to shift my stuff next saturday
We're relocating from a third-floor flat to a house across town at the end of the month and want a team to pack, load and unload everything.

description: get someone to assemble flat pack furniture
utterances: got a wardrobe in boxes and no patience to build it
I've just had a bed frame, two bookcases and a desk delivered still in their packaging, could someone come and put them all together this weekend?

description: get a broken washing machine repaired
utterances: my washer is making a horrible grinding noise mid cycle
The drum on my front loader stopped spinning halfway through a wash and now it's full of water and won't drain, is this something you can repair at home?

description: book pest control for an infestation
utterances: i keep finding mouse droppings in the kitchen cupboards
We've spotted cockroaches in the bathroom three nights in a row and I'm worried they've nested somewhere, I need someone to come and treat the whole flat.

description: book a gardener to tidy an overgrown garden
utterances: the lawn is knee high can someone come cut it
The back garden has been neglected since spring, the hedges need trimming and the beds are full of weeds, I'd like a couple of hours of help.

description: book exterior window cleaning
utterances: the outside of my windows are filthy can someone do them
I live on the second floor and can't reach the outer glass myself, could you send someone with ladders to do all the front and back panes?

description: book carpet or sofa cleaning
utterances: the dog ruined the living room rug can you shampoo it
There are several stains on the hallway carpet and the fabric sofa smells musty, I'd like both steam cleaned in one visit if that's possible.

description: book a service for the air conditioner
utterances: my aircon needs a clean before summer hits
The wall unit in the bedroom has started blowing musty air and dripping a little, I'd like a technician to come and do a full maintenance check on it.

description: get a locksmith to change the door locks
utterances: just moved in and want all the locks swapped out
My previous flatmate still has a set of keys and I'd feel safer with new cylinders on the front and back doors, can someone come this week?

description: move a booked appointment to another day
utterances: can we push the cleaner to thursday instead
Something has come up at work on the day the plumber is due, could we shift that visit to any day next week that has availability?

description: change the arrival time on the day of the visit
utterances: can they come at two instead of ten today
The appointment is still today but I've been called into the office this morning, would it be possible for the technician to come after four instead?

description: cancel a booked appointment
utterances: i don't need the electrician anymore please scrap it
My neighbour ended up fixing the problem for me, so I'd like to call off the visit scheduled for Friday and check whether any fee applies.

description: change the address for an upcoming visit
utterances: i put the wrong flat on the booking
The cleaner is booked to come to my old place next week but I've since moved, how do I update the location so she goes to the new house?

description: add extra tasks to an existing booking
utterances: can the cleaner also do the oven when she comes
I already have a visit booked for Saturday, but I'd like to include the inside of the fridge and the balcony as well, will that need more time?

description: keep the same cleaner for future visits
utterances: the lady who came last time was brilliant can i have her again
The person you sent on Tuesday knew exactly how I like things done, is there a way to make sure she's assigned to all my future visits?

description: get a different cleaner next time
utterances: i'd rather not have the same guy back next week
The person who came last time was fine but we didn't really click, could you assign someone else for the remaining visits without cancelling the plan?

description: get a price estimate before booking
utterances: how much would it be to get my three bed house cleaned
Before I commit to anything, could you tell me roughly what it costs to have two bathrooms retiled, including labour and whether materials are separate?

description: dispute a final price higher than the quote
utterances: why is the bill double what i was told

description: report the worker never turned up
utterances: waited in all day and nobody came

description: ask where the worker is because they are late
utterances: the plumber was meant to be here at nine any idea where he is

description: complain the job was done badly
utterances: the floors are still sticky after the so-called clean
The electrician left exposed wiring behind the socket and the cover plate doesn't sit flush, honestly the workmanship is nowhere near what I paid for.

description: have the job redone at no extra cost
utterances: can someone come back and finish the job properly
The bathroom was barely touched during yesterday's visit, I'd like a second visit to do it again properly and I don't expect to be billed for it.

description: report property damaged during the visit
utterances: the movers scratched my hardwood floor badly

description: complain about a rude worker
utterances: the guy you sent was really rude to my mum
The technician who came this morning was dismissive when I asked questions, made snide comments about the state of the house and I don't want him back.

description: report an item missing after the visit
utterances: a bracelet is gone from my dresser since the clean
After the cleaning visit on Monday I noticed some cash I'd left in the kitchen drawer is no longer there, I'd like this looked into formally.
